data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in SHIM, SMID, and ESOA.

On October 8, SHIM reported entering into a material definitive agreement in an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1887944/000119312526418076/shim-20261002.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

May I send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
